failure_texts.en: Have you circled B? If not, you go elsewhere. If you have, read on:

texts.en: We spot Gilly picking up discarded rotten fruit and putting it in a bag. Then she buys a sailor’s knife – the type normally used for gutting fish and cutting rope. As we follow her out of the market, she looks round, and seems to realise we’re following her. A moment later, she’s vanished.
